about: The sample data, made fresh from this list each time with every date counted from the day the data is made. crm/sample_data.py turns the offsets into dates and adds the records.

The organizations, the first 15 contacts, all 40 deals, the first 9 follow-ups and the recent activity are the records shown in the mockups (docs/mockups/). On Mon Nov 16, 2026 they give the mockups' figures: open pipeline $9,040,000 across 17 deals, expected revenue $3,481,000, won this month $1,080,000 from 2 deals, won in the last 12 months $7,710,000 from 16 deals, 3 deals late.
Every other activity and stage change is older than the tenth recent item, so the dashboard's recent activity matches the mockup on that date.

dates.daysFromToday: That many days after today, or before it when negative.
dates.monthsAgoAndDay: For won deals: that day of the month, monthsAgo calendar months before the current month. A day past the end of a short month becomes its last day, and a date after today becomes today. This keeps the right wins in each month on any date, including the 1st and the 31st.
dates.time: Local time of day, 24-hour. An entry dated today whose time is still to come is moved to a few minutes before the data is made, so recent activity never shows the future.
dates.onCloseDate: The stage change happens on the deal's close date, since moving a deal to Won or Lost sets its close date.
dates.daysBeforeClose: For closed deals: that many days before the deal's close date.
dates.dueInDays: A follow-up's date: that many days after today, or before it when negative.

boardOrder: Deals are listed in board order within each stage: the first open deal at a stage is the top card in its column. Won and Lost are newest first.
